verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only Gitea's built-in issue tracking (columns, labels, milestones, dependencies), plus CI/chat integrations and webhooks. Nothing documents connecting an external issue tracker, viewing or managing its tickets inside Gitea, or opening them from pull requests. Built-in issues and chat or CI integrations are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view and manage tickets from an external issue tracker inside the code host and open them from pull requests
